doc.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016

title: Volume on stage and McDonald as a person
summary: He describes the painful volume near the monitors and praises McDonald as a nice, unaffected man.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Yeah I know what you mean by loud. Because I’ve played in some loud bands and that can be —

Yeah, there were times when I would walk over by Mike’s monitors, and it was like a certain frequency would come out and it was like somebody just punched you in the face. You’d step back and immediately leave the zone. But it was a great band. Every incarnation of the band over those almost 20 years, we had great people in the band. And Mike is a super nice guy, easy to work with, unaffected, really a good dude.
